source.name: WMNCYCLING (team site): 'NEW ERA FOR CANYON//SRAM AS TEAM EMBRACES WE FEMMES'
source.quote: Designed by Canyon and new partner RYZON, this stunning WeFemmes jersey celebrates how far we've come
source.note: RYZON is the team's apparel partner ('official kit partner', TOUR, 31 July 2026); its small purple 'R' brand mark sits beside CANYON on the viewer's-right chest (see Ryzon replica cutout in the canyon entry). Ryzon sells the replica (https://ryzon.net/en-int/products/canyon-x-sram-we-femmes-cycling-jersey-men, 'the official jersey of the CANYON//SRAM WorldTour Team').

summary: Current 2026 UCI Women's WorldTeam kit ('WeFemmes', designed by Canyon, made by new apparel partner RYZON, first raced at the Tour de France Femmes on 1 August 2026). Canyon, SRAM and Zwift cover the chest and bibs; SRAM and Zwift are also on the sleeves; kit maker RYZON's brand mark sits on the chest. zondacrypto, co-title sponsor of the 2026 'Luminous' kit raced January to May, was dropped on 29 May 2026 'following breaches of contract' (team announcement) and appears on nothing current; the UCI registration still carries the name. Scalable Capital joined on 1 August 2026 but its logo is on helmets and team vehicles only, not on the kit (team article). Checked against Ryzon's replica jersey cutouts (front/back), Canyon's official TT-suit cutouts and a TdFF Stage 1 race photo.
